palindrome: Able was I ere I saw Elba. I wandered lonely as a cloud. Then came a soft breeze which whispered "Are you okay?" I replied with glee, "I am not, so please blow away the clouds and let me find my way." The breeze obliged, blowing away all the clouds and revealing a beautiful landscape ahead. As I walked on, I noticed that the path I was following was not only beautiful but also magical. Suddenly, a fairy appeared before me. She said, "I am glad to see you safe. You were in danger but now you are free." She gave me a magical wand and told me to use it wisely. I thanked her and promised to do so. As I continued on my journey, I felt a sense of peace and joy that I had never experienced before. The path was illuminated by the light from the stars above, and I knew that no matter where life took me, I would always have this magical moment to remember.
